Title: Preferred tool order
Text: 1. Read the bounded deliverable-local files listed in the skill contract. 2. Use direct reasoning to extract and summarize structured information into the seven-section digest.

Title: TASK-enforced
Text: None. The `allowed-tools` frontmatter field is intentionally omitted.

Title: Expected use of reasoning
Text: This skill performs bounded extraction and summarization only. It should identify specific quality-observation signals from the deliverable-local files without crossing into engineering judgment or cross-deliverable synthesis.

Title: Disallowed use
Text: - No writes outside `OUTPUT_PATH`. - No modification of any file in `DELIVERABLE_PATH`. - No reading files outside the specified deliverable folder. - No cross-deliverable scanning or comparison.

Title: Write boundary
Text: The skill may write exactly one file at `RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_PATH`.
